_note: Planting stock and breeding herds for crops and milk cattle that the tree grants as living stock and no other production file makes. Rates of increase and loss, and their sources, are in data/world/living_stock.json.

sugar_cane_sett_kg.basis: per hectare of seed-cane nursery per year, output as kg of setts for planting out
sugar_cane_sett_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. A seed-cane hectare supplies planting material for about eleven hectares by conventional multiplication, and a hectare is planted with five to six tonnes of setts, so about sixty tonnes of setts per nursery hectare (Cane Advisory Services seed rate; planting-techniques review). LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The sourced propagation facts are in data/world/living_stock.json; the per-hectare output and the labour here are estimates, not checked against a source. Conf C. Made only where the crop is already grown, so the stock cannot be had without a society that holds it.

pepper_vine_stock_kg.basis: per hectare of pepper nursery and mother vines per year, output as kg of rooted cuttings
pepper_vine_stock_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. Mother vines give dozens of cuttings a year each at a high rooting rate (TNAU Agritech Portal, Pepper); the kilograms of rooted cuttings per hectare is an order-of-magnitude estimate. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The sourced propagation facts are in data/world/living_stock.json; the per-hectare output and the labour here are estimates, not checked against a source. Conf C. Made only where the crop is already grown, so the stock cannot be had without a society that holds it.

tea_plant_stock_kg.basis: per hectare of tea mother bushes per year, output as kg of rooted cuttings
tea_plant_stock_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. A mother bush gives tens to hundreds of cuttings a year at a high survival rate (tea clonal-propagation leaflet; University of Hawaii CTAHR SCM-35); the kilograms of rooted cuttings per hectare is an order-of-magnitude estimate. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The sourced propagation facts are in data/world/living_stock.json; the per-hectare output and the labour here are estimates, not checked against a source. Conf C. Made only where the crop is already grown, so the stock cannot be had without a society that holds it.

coffee_seedling_kg.basis: per hectare of coffee nursery per year, output as kg of seedlings ready for the field
coffee_seedling_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. Seedlings stay six to nine months in the nursery with a fifth to a third lost (Agriculture Institute, coffee propagation); the kilograms per nursery hectare is an order-of-magnitude estimate. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The sourced propagation facts are in data/world/living_stock.json; the per-hectare output and the labour here are estimates, not checked against a source. Conf C. Made only where the crop is already grown, so the stock cannot be had without a society that holds it.

dairy_cattle_kg.basis: per hectare of breeding pasture per year, output as kg of live weight of milk cattle reared to first calving
dairy_cattle_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. Cows calve and the heifers are reared on grass and hay to first calving. Live-weight gain on extensive pasture is taken as the draught_animal_kg entry's figure; the calving and mortality rates are sourced in data/world/living_stock.json (FAO traditional-systems review). LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The sourced propagation facts are in data/world/living_stock.json; the per-hectare output and the labour here are estimates, not checked against a source. Conf C. Made only where the crop is already grown, so the stock cannot be had without a society that holds it.

potato_seed_tuber_kg.basis: per hectare of crop grown for seed tubers per year, output as kg
potato_seed_tuber_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. A potato crop lifted and the small tubers kept for planting; 10000 kg of tubers per hectare is an order-of-magnitude estimate for hand-tilled ground, not checked against a source. LABOUR: wheat_kg's 150 labourer-hours per hectare plus an estimated allowance for hilling and lifting; storage is not added. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The held-stock rates are in data/world/living_stock.json. Made only where the crop is already grown. Conf C.

maize_seed_kg.basis: per hectare of crop grown for seed grain per year, output as kg
maize_seed_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. A maize crop left to ripen and the ears kept for sowing; 2000 kg of grain per hectare is an order-of-magnitude estimate for hand-tilled ground, not checked against a source. LABOUR: borrowed from wheat_kg's 150 labourer-hours per hectare of hand-tilled field crop; shelling and drying are not added. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The held-stock rates are in data/world/living_stock.json. Made only where the crop is already grown. Conf C.

cacao_seed_kg.basis: per hectare of crop grown for beans for planting per year, output as kg
cacao_seed_kg.yield_basis: GROWN. A cacao grove with pods kept for planting; 500 kg of fresh beans per hectare is an order-of-magnitude estimate, not checked against a source. LABOUR: an estimated allowance for tending and harvesting pods by hand; the nursery is not added. LAND: the batch is one hectare-year, converted to hectare_land's unit as in wheat_kg's LAND note. The held-stock rates are in data/world/living_stock.json. Made only where the crop is already grown. Conf C.
